question: Which deity is said to have worshipped this Tripurā vidyā?
premises: This vidyā is identified as Tripurā.
It is stated to have been worshipped by the Sun.
inference: The Tripurā vidyā is transmitted with the authority of worship by the Sun.
plain_english: O beautiful-hipped one, this vidyā is Tripurā, worshipped by the Sun.
